As a member of the Rural Health Caucus, I had the opportunity to participate in a roundtable to discuss bipartisan policy solutions to improve access to quality, affordable healthcare. 

Rural communities in Western New York and the Southern Tier face unique challenges when it comes to healthcare access, including provider shortages, geographic barriers, and limited resources. It's crucial that we work together across party lines to address these issues and ensure that all Americans, regardless of where they live, have access to the healthcare they need.

When Joe Biden took office, inflation was at just 1.4%. Under his reckless policies, inflation has risen by 18.6%.

🏥 Hospital services are UP 6.1% 
💊 Nonprescription drugs are UP 9.3% 
🚗 Motor vehicle insurance is UP 20.6% 
🍼 Baby food and formula are UP 8.8%

Bidenomics has stolen the American dream from young families.  

Under President Biden’s reckless policies, home prices, interest rates, and homeowners insurance have skyrocketed — making home ownership unattainable for many. This trend cannot be allowed to continue if we want a secure financial future for America.

Today, I met with interim leadership at the Buffalo VA Medical Center to tour the facility and discuss the administrative failures that have caused unacceptable delays in cancer treatment for our veterans. 

I’m committed to working with the VA and the House Veterans Affairs Committee to get answers, hold those responsible accountable, and make sure this never happens again. Our veterans deserve nothing less than the timely, lifesaving care they earned and deserve.

So many veterans in WNY rely on the Buffalo VA for care, and it should be nothing less than the best care possible. 

I’m working to get to the bottom of the administrative failures causing delays in cancer treatment and ensure it never happens again. @WKBW https://t.co/e1Ww47Yw89

Today, I’m proud to announce that the City of Jamestown will receive $187,672 in new federal funding to support substance abuse and mental health services.

Jamestown has been grappling with the dual crises of substance abuse and encampments of those facing homelessness, so this grant couldn't come at a more critical time. Mayor Kim Ecklund has shown tremendous leadership in addressing these issues since taking office in January.
https://t.co/k10iH94tgc

Western New York and the Southern Tier are proud to have so many hardworking men and women pursuing a technical career education, but despite them being a vital part of our workforce, too many of these students face mental health challenges without access to the same federal resources available to others.

Today, I introduced H.R. 9656, the bipartisan Career and Technical Education (CTE) Student Mental Health and Wellness Act with @CongressmanGT and @RepBonamici to change that.

Thank you to cosponsors @RepLCD, @RepBrianFitz, @RepDonDavis, @RepBost, @RepDesposito, @RepMichaelRulli, @RepMoylan, and @RepDonBacon.

Read more: https://t.co/q29IDln6MH

From addressing local veterans’ healthcare issues to improving infrastructure, my focus remains on delivering results for our communities.

Today, I had the opportunity to address the incredible medical professionals who are part of the Community Oncology Alliance.

We discussed their vital work on the front lines of cancer care and the steps we’re taking in Congress to support them, including passing key legislation to improve access to life-saving medications, lower healthcare costs, and hold PBMs accountable for their harmful practices.

My joint statement with @RepTimKennedy following our meeting with VA Under Secretary for Health Dr. Shereef Elnahal today:

"We want to thank Undersecretary Shereef Elnahal for meeting with us today and prioritizing the necessary changes at the Buffalo VA to ensure our heroes receive the care they deserve. We have full confidence in his commitment to accountability and transparency as we work together to restore trust and prevent failures like this from ever happening again. We’re already seeing meaningful improvements, and through continued congressional oversight, we’ll guarantee these changes are fully implemented and that veterans always come first. 

Throughout this process, the hardworking medical staff at the Buffalo VA and their community partners have continued to show their dedication to our veterans—they deserve a new state-of-the-art facility and strong leadership that can help them fulfill our promise of world-class care for our veterans."
